mapper.sql: device_id, user_id, credential_hash, client_id, device_name, platform, app_version, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_device ( device_id, user_id, credential_hash, client_id, device_name, platform, app_version, expires_at, last_used_at ) VALUES ( CAST(#{deviceId} AS UUID), #{userId}, #{credentialHash}, #{clientId}, #{deviceName}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, #{expiresAt}, #{lastUsedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_device WHERE device_id = CAST(#{deviceId} AS UUID)
